ops.title: PostToolUse scan source: rubric case f08 passes the gate on paper but produces no verdict
ops.description: Round-3 rubric panel case f08 (assistant writeup ~509 chars with a numbered list + 'let me know what you think', then PostToolUse tool_name=Read): manual regex math gives S2(1)+S3(2)=3 >= threshold 3, yet two live runs of uvx capt-hook run PostToolUse returned no verdict (only the unwired-SubagentStop notice) from both untrusted and trusted cwds. Plan: instrument/inspect what transcript_texts feeds the Signals scorer for PostToolUse (per-message vs joined, window semantics), find why the score misses threshold, pin with a harness test; fix or document the intended semantics.

ops.text: root cause identified and pinned by a harness test reproducing f08's transcript shape
